{{Current events|year=2019|month=08|day=20|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (April 2019–present)|2019 Northwestern Syria offensive]]
**The [[Al-Qaeda]]-linked faction [[Hayat Tahrir al-Sham]] (HTS) acknowledges "a redeployment" south of the strategic town of [[Khan Shaykhun]]. [https://apnews.com/7385d040867247ddbf7bbfae99847e04 (AP News)]
**Pro-government media reports that the [[Syrian Army]] has entered the northern sector of the town of Khan Shaykhun, following the reported HTS withdrawal. [https://www.almasdarnews.com/article/breaking-syrian-army-enters-khan-sheikhoun-to-secure-city/ (Al-Masdar)]

;Health and enviornment
*The [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Spanish Ministry of Health]] declares an outbreak of [[listeriosis]] in [[Andalusia]] as a national health alert after cases are reported in Asturias, Madrid, Catalonia and Extremadura, including one death. [http://www.rtve.es/noticias/20190820/sanidad-decreta-alerta-sanitaria-nacional-brote-listeriosis-detectado-andalucia/1977367.shtml (RTVE)]

;Law and crime
*[[Crime in Brazil]]
**Thirty-seven passengers on a bus over [[Rio–Niterói Bridge]], [[Rio de Janeiro (state)|Rio de Janeiro state]], [[Brazil]], are held hostage before police shoot dead the armed hijacker. After closer inspection, police discover the hijacker used a fake plastic gun. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49406032 (BBC)], [https://extra.globo.com/casos-de-policia/sequestrador-de-onibus-na-ponte-rio-niteroi-usava-arma-de-brinquedo-afirma-porta-voz-da-policia-militar-23889013.html (''Extra'')]
*Former professional basketball player [[Mateen Cleaves]] is acquitted of several sex crimes in a court in his hometown of [[Flint, Michigan]]. [https://www.mlive.com/news/flint/2019/08/mateen-cleaves-found-not-guilty-in-sex-assault-trial.html (MLive)], [https://www.abc12.com/content/news/Mateen-Cleaves-found-not-guilty-of-sexual-assault-charges-557032331.html (WJRT-TV)]
*A modification of the [[Volcker rule]] is approved by the [[Office of the Comptroller of the Currency|OCC]] and the [[Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation|FDIC]]. The new version eases rules on [[proprietary trading]] by Wall Street banks but is criticized by consumer groups who see risks for the protections on taxpayer money. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-banks-volcker/u-s-regulators-hand-wall-street-a-major-win-with-stripped-down-volcker-rule-idUSKCN1VA1B8 (Reuters)]
*The [[Texas Department of Information Resources]] reports the computer systems of 23 towns in the state were hit by a [[ransomware]] attack on August 16. "One single threat actor" is suspected. [https://www.insider.com/texas-ransomware-attack-affects-23-towns-single-attacker-2019-8 (Insider)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Italy]], [[Conte Cabinet]]
**The [[President of Italy]] accepts [[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] [[Giuseppe Conte]]'s resignation. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-italy-politics-president-decision/italys-president-accepts-contes-resignation-calls-for-consultations-idUSKCN1VA22L (Reuters)] 

;Science and technology
*[[List of unmanned aerial vehicles]]
**The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defence]] announces that the six-tonne satellite-controlled reconnaissance drone [[Altius-U]] has performed its maiden flight. [https://tass.com/defense/1074237 (TASS)]
